description: This file defines the IpfsManager class, which manages IPFS gateway settings, preferences, and related operations within an Android application using Kotlin. It handles enabling/disabling IPFS, managing default and user-defined gateways, and persisting preferences.

classes.name: IpfsManager
classes.description: Manages IPFS gateway preferences, enabling/disabling IPFS, and user/default gateway lists within the app.

methods.name: setIpfsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables IPFS functionality and updates preferences.

methods.name: setDefaultGatewayEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific default IPFS gateway.

methods.name: addUserGateway
methods.description: Adds a new user-defined IPFS gateway URL, avoiding default gateways.

methods.name: removeUserGateway
methods.description: Removes a user-defined IPFS gateway URL.

methods.name: loadPreferences
methods.description: Loads current IPFS preferences from persistent storage.

methods.name: parseJsonStringArray
methods.description: Parses a JSON array string into a list of strings.

methods.name: toJsonStringArray
methods.description: Converts a list of strings into a JSON array string.
